nodes.label: Talkie Methods, Not Weights Proposal
nodes.description: Design proposal keeps Gemma 4 9B IT as the actor while porting Talkie's period-cutoff, mined-reference supervision, preference judging, and staged training methodology.

nodes.label: No-Anchor Dual Local Judges
nodes.description: Hand-authored anchors and frontier API judges are removed; Talkie likelihood scores period fit and Qwen 3.5 scores coherence to build DPO preferences on the same cloud GPU.

nodes.label: RunPod A100 Training Path
nodes.description: RunPod A100-80GB becomes the primary hosted path because actor, reference model, Talkie, and Qwen judges fit concurrently, enabling SFT plus DPO for an estimated nine-hour clean run.

edges.description: The dual-judge DPO design is one of the two recommended Talkie methodology ports.
